name: Jeb Baker
occupation: Platte County commissioner (current term continues past 2026)
prior_offices: Platte County commissioner (won the November 2024 general election; listed on the official commissioners page)
background: Jeb Baker is a Platte County commissioner. He won the November 2024 general election, and the official commissioners page lists him as a member. Cowboy State Daily reported that he was present and voted to accept Sheriff David Russell's resignation in August 2025. He was not on the 2026 county-commission ballot.

sources.name: Cowboy State Daily, Aug. 26, 2025, Brief: Platte County Sheriff David Russell Resigns
